original: evaṃ bhagavataḥ sādhanavidhim upadiśya cakrādinā śāntikādyarthaṃ nānādevatābhāvanāyāṃ tārayati | śṛṇv ityādi | vajro vajragarbhaḥ | bhīmo bhīmasena itivat | sādhyām iti | śāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ vaśyaṃ rakṣā(265v/534)m abhicāraṃ ca | viśeṣato varṇādiviśeṣeṇa | śāntiṃ vartamānasyāpakārasya rakṣā tu bhaviṣyataḥ |
analyzed: evam bhagavataḥ sādhana vidhim upadiśya cakra ādinā śāntika ādi artham nānā devatā bhāvanāyām tārayati śṛṇu ityādi vajraḥ vajragarbhaḥ bhīmaḥ bhīmasenaḥ iti vat sādhyām iti śāntim puṣṭim vaśyam rakṣām abhicāram ca viśeṣataḥ varṇa ādi viśeṣeṇa śāntim vartamānasya apakārasya rakṣā tu bhaviṣyataḥ

original: navakoṣṭhādicakrasyeti | aṣṭabhir arair varaṭena saha nava koṣṭhā yasya tac ca ādiś ca vakṣyamāṇacakrāpekṣayā cakraṃ ca | tasya bāhye nemim | karmavarṇādīti karmānurūpaṃ varṇāśayādikaṃ bhāvayet | asyeti mantrasya bījaṃ tādibījāni | sarveṣāṃ pūrvāgnyādikoṣṭhānām | (266r/535) praṇava oṁ | hutaṃ svāhā | tasyāntimā lipir hā | madhya nāmam iti |
analyzed: nava koṣṭha ādi cakrasya iti aṣṭabhiḥ araiḥ varaṭena saha nava koṣṭhāḥ yasya tat ca ādiḥ ca vakṣyamāṇa cakra apekṣayā cakram ca tasya bāhye nemim karma varṇa ādi iti karma anurūpam varṇa āśaya ādikam bhāvayet asya iti mantrasya bījam ta ādi bījāni sarveṣām pūrva agni ādi koṣṭhānām praṇavaḥ om hutam svāhā tasya antimā lipiḥ hā madhya nāmam iti

original: varaṭe oṁhākārayor madhye sādhyasya nāma rakṣāvākyasahitam | samatājñānaṃ śūnyatājñānaṃ tad eva śūnyaṃ tena yuktam ātmānaṃ kuryāt | samatāsarvavit śūnyatājñānaṃ paramā rakṣā sthāne cakre ca bhāvitā | atas tāṃ yojayet | evaṃ sati rakṣā bhavati jñāninām | bhayam upadravabhūtaṃ | dūrato na bhavatīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: varaṭe oṁhākārayoḥ madhye sādhyasya nāma rakṣā vākya sahitam samatā jñānam śūnyatā jñānam tat eva śūnyam tena yuktam ātmānam kuryāt samatā sarva vid śūnyatā jñānam paramā rakṣā sthāne cakre ca bhāvitā atas tām yojayet evam sati rakṣā bhavati jñāninām bhayam upadrava bhūtam dūratas na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: tato 'bhāvena śūnyatayā sattvā(266v/536)nām ity upalakṣaṇaṃ bhājanalokasya | yogabhāvaṃ devatāniṣpattim | cakṣur iti cakṣuṣoḥ | nāsam iti nāsayoḥ | śiraḥprabhṛtīnām antaḥsuṣirasthāny akṣarāṇi | sādhayet sarvakarmāṇīti śāntikādīni | sarvadevānām iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ | sarvadevān apīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas bhāvena śūnyatayā sattvānām iti upalakṣaṇam bhājana lokasya yoga bhāvam devatā niṣpattim cakṣuḥ iti cakṣuṣoḥ nāsam iti nāsayoḥ śiraḥ prabhṛtīnām antar suṣira sthāni akṣarāṇi sādhayet sarva karmāṇi iti śāntika ādīni sarva devānām iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ sarva devān api iti arthaḥ

original: ayam arthaḥ | sarvadharmaśūnyatāṃ vicintya jhaṭitijātasitāravinde candre tāṁpariṇataṃ tāṁkārādhiṣṭhitavaraṭam utpalaṃ tatpariṇatām āryatārāṃ sattva(267r/537)paryaṅkiṇīṃ vicitraratnādinepathyām abhayasavyakarāṃ vāmenotpalaṃ bibhratīṃ vairocanamudritām ātmānaṃ vibhāvya yathoktamantraiḥ kavacayitvā hṛdabjacandrasthāṣṭāracakrasya nābhau oṁ devadattaṃ
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ sarva dharma śūnyatām vicintya jhaṭiti jāta sita aravinde candre tāṁ pariṇatam tāṁkāra adhiṣṭhita varaṭam utpalam tad pariṇatām ārya tārām sattva paryaṅkiṇīm vicitra ratna ādi nepathyām abhaya savya karām vāmena utpalam bibhratīm vairocana mudritām ātmānam vibhāvya yathā ukta mantraiḥ kavacayitvā hṛd abja candra stha aṣṭa āra cakrasya nābhau oṃ devadattam devadattam devadattam devadattam devadattam devadattam devadattam devadattam devadatt

original: rakṣa hā | pūrvāgnyādyareṣu dakṣiṇāvartena tāre tuttāre ture svā iti bhāvayet | varṇas tu bhagavatyāḥ padmasya cakrasyākṣarāṇāṃ raśmīnāṃ ca karmānusāraṃ jñātavyaḥ | (267v/538) tatra śāntau rakṣāyāṃ ca śuklaḥ | puṣṭau pīṭaḥ | vaśye raktaḥ | abhicāre kṛṣṇaḥ | svadehacakrākṣararaśmibhiḥ prabhūtair vyāpyamānaṃ sādhyaṃ cintayan mantraṃ japet |
analyzed: rakṣa hā pūrva agni ādi areṣu dakṣiṇa āvartena tāre svāḥ iti bhāvayet varṇaḥ tu bhagavatyāḥ padmasya cakrasya akṣarāṇām raśmīnām ca karma anusāram jñātavyaḥ tatra śāntau rakṣāyām ca śuklaḥ puṣṭau pīṭaḥ vaśye raktaḥ abhicāre kṛṣṇaḥ sva deha cakra akṣara raśmibhiḥ prabhūtaiḥ vyāpyamānam sādhyam cintayan mantram japet

original: oṁ tāre tuttāre ture svāheti | svāhāpūrvaṃ yathāyogaṃ vidarbhaṇam | pūrvasevākāle tu na vidarbhayet |
analyzed: om tāre tut tāre ture svāhā iti svāhā pūrvam yathāyogam vidarbhaṇam pūrvasevā kāle tu na vidarbhayet

original: bhūrje tu padmenducakrākṣarāṇi likhitvā sabhūrjāny ūrdhvarandhreṇāntaḥ praveśya hṛtpadmādibhir ekīkṛtyādho bhagavatīpadmadvāreṇa niṣkāśya (268r/539) dhārayed abhimataṃ syāt | pratiṣṭhāpītthaṃ vidyāyā ity āmnāyaḥ | ayaṃ ca vidhir vakṣyamāṇayogayor api yathāyogaṃ boddhavyaḥ | vaśyakarmaṇi kurukullā viśiṣyate | sā bhagavatī tāraiva |
analyzed: bhūrje tu padma indu cakra akṣarāṇi likhitvā sa bhūrjāni ūrdhva randhreṇa antar praveśya hṛd padma ādibhiḥ ekīkṛtya adhas bhagavatī padma dvāreṇa niṣkāśya dhārayet abhimatam syāt pratiṣṭhā api ittham vidyāyāḥ iti āmnāyaḥ ayam ca vidhiḥ vakṣyamāṇa yogayoḥ api yathāyogam boddhavyaḥ vaśya karmaṇi kurukullā viśiṣyate sā bhagavatī tārā eva

original: śūnyatābhāvanānantaraṃ jhagiti raktābjaśavasūrye raktahrīḥkārapariṇatādhiṣṭhitaraktotpalapariṇatāṃ kurukullāṃ raktām ekavaktrāṃ caladraktavartulatrinetrāṃ piṅgordhvamūrdhajām amitābha(268v/540)mudritāṃ śiraḥsthapañcakapālacakryādyābharaṇāṃ galāvalambitamuṇḍamālāṃ caturbhujāṃ dakṣiṇābhyāṃ raktotpalakalikāśaraṃ raktapuṣpakṛtāṅkuśaṃ ca vāmābhyāṃ
analyzed: śūnyatā bhāvanā anantaram jha c iti rakta abja śava sūrye rakta hrīḥkāra pariṇata adhiṣṭhita rakta utpala pariṇatām kurukullām raktām eka vaktrām calat rakta vartula tri netrām piṅga ūrdhva mūrdhajām amita ābha mudritām śiraḥ stha pañca kapāla cakrī ādi ābharaṇām gala avalambita muṇḍa mālām catur bhujām dakṣiṇābhyām rakta utpala kalikā śaram rakta puṣpa kṛta aṅkuśam ca vāmābhyām rakta utpala kalikā śaram rakta puṣpa kṛta aṅkuśam ca

analyzed: rakta kusuma dhanū rakta utpalam ca bibhratīm ardha paryaṅkeṇa nṛtyantīm vicintya sva hṛd sūrya stha cakra akṣara raśmibhiḥ ākṛṣṭam sādhyam vihvalībhūtam vyāpayantīm utpalena gale baddhvā puruṣam hṛdi striyam aṅkuśena pīḍayantīm śara jālaiḥ vidhyantīm ātmānam bhāvayan mantram japet vaśyā artham

original: cakraṃ tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇam aṣṭapattrapadmasūryastham | areṣu oṁ kurukulle svā madhye hrīḥ amukīṃ vaśīkuru hrīḥ hā akṣarāṇi yojayet | likhanadravyaṃ tu vakṣyate | bandhanaśamanādiṣu yathāyogaṃ vidhir unneyaḥ | ghoreti | nāgānām | jvarāpamṛtyuviṣaśamane śubhreyam | idaṃ rakṣeti | iyaṃ cāsau rakṣā ceti kṛtvā |
analyzed: cakram tu vakṣyamāṇam ṣaṭkoṇam aṣṭa pattra padma sūrya stham areṣu oṃ kurukulle svā madhye hrīḥ amukīm vaśīkuru hrīḥ hā akṣarāṇi yojayet likhana dravyam tu vakṣyate bandhana śamana ādiṣu yathāyogam vidhiḥ unneyaḥ ghorā iti nāgānām jvara apamṛtyu viṣa śamane śubhrā iyam idam rakṣā iti iyam ca asau rakṣā ca iti kṛtvā

analyzed: ayam arthaḥ śūnyatā anantaram sita abja indau hūṃ aja adhiṣṭhita abja prajñāpāramitā pustaka pariṇatām prajñāpāramitām śuklām sattva paryaṅkām ratna ādi nepathyām akṣobhya mudritām dvi bhujām prajñāpāramitā aṅka kamala dvayam vāma dakṣiṇa pārśvayoḥ antar utthitam kaphoṇibhyām dhṛtvā karābhyām vyākhyāna mudrayā sthitām ātmānam bhāvayet

original: ayam arthaḥ | śūnyatānantaraṃ viśvābjaraktāpūrṇakapālacandre vuṁkārajā(271r/545)dhiṣṭhitacakracihnajātaṃ vairocanaṃ śuklaṃ jaṭāmukuṭinam ardhaparyaṅkatāṇḍavinaṃ hṛccandrasthabījajasaraśmisvābhadevatābhir jagadajñānatamo 'panīya buddhatve pratiṣṭhāpayantam ātmānaṃ dhyāyād iti | uttaratrāpi yathāyogam ayaṃ vidhiḥ | ata āha | etenetyādi |
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ śūnyatā anantaram viśva abja rakta āpūrṇa kapāla candre vairocanam śuklam jaṭā mukuṭinam ardha paryaṅka tāṇḍavinam hṛd candra stha bīja ja sa raśmi sva ābha devatābhiḥ upanīya buddhatve pratiṣṭhāpayantam ātmānam dhyāyāt iti uttaratra api yathāyogam ayam vidhiḥ atas āha etena ityādi

original: savyeṣu cakravajrakhaḍgabāṇāḥ | mukuṭe kapālāni pañca | vairocanādyaṣṭadevatānām api cakryādyābharaṇāny api | rogādyupadravaśamanam | māmakyā vajraṃ cihnam | (272v/548) savyeṣu vajracakraratnapadmakhaḍgabāṇāḥ | bhītādyanugrahakaraṇam | pāṇḍarāyāś cihnaṃ padmam | savyeṣu padmavajrakhaḍgabāṇāḥ | kṣīṇānāṃ puṣṭikaraṇam | tārāyāś cihnaṃ raktotpalam |
